scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run --directory backend ruff format src
scripts.format:check: biome format . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check src
scripts.lint: biome check frontend package.json biome.json && uv run --directory backend ruff check src
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && uv run --directory backend pyright
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --directory backend uvicorn main:app --app-dir src --reload --reload-dir src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
